prompt: Take the 2025 cohort to be the enrolled participants in IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY (those with a STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID). What share of that cohort has any HealthKit resting heart rate data, and how many person-days of it do they contribute in total? Exploratory is fine: no plan needed.
tests: the cohort applied to numerator and denominator: people outside it, a duplicate cohort row

checks.name: cohort share
checks.detail: expected 58 of 136 (42.6%): the cohort has 137 summary rows for 136 people, and 66 people in the table include 8 outside the cohort

checks.name: person-days, no duplicate-join inflation
checks.detail: expected 16,906, 19,369 or 19,297 person-days (by day rule); joining the duplicate summary row gives 17,244 and the like

answer:
Exploratory bottom line: in the requested 2025 enrolled cohort, **58 of 136 participants** had any HealthKit resting heart rate data, so the share is **42.6%**. Those participants contributed **19,297 person-days** total, counting distinct enrolled participant plus local calendar day from HealthKit `STARTDATE`.

I used `IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY` for the cohort denominator and `IHS_2025.HEALTHKITSAMPLES_RESTINGHEARTRATE` for the HealthKit RHR data, joined by `PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER`. I used `STARTDATE` rather than `RECORD_DATE` because a check showed those dates are not interchangeable for person-day counts.

Report: `/work/outputs/healthkit_rhr_coverage_2025.html`  
Summary CSV: `/work/outputs/healthkit_rhr_coverage_2025_summary.csv`  
Source script: `/work/scripts/healthkit_rhr_coverage_2025.py`

Limitations: this is descriptive coverage only, not an adherence or health interpretation. The local KB was not mounted, so I relied on live catalog/table metadata. I also suggested a KB update noting the `STARTDATE` vs `RECORD_DATE` issue for HealthKit RHR.
queries:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS summary_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) AS distinct_participantidentifiers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID) AS distinct_study_participant_ids,
  SUM(CASE WHEN STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_with_study_participant_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER END) AS enrolled_participantidentifiers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID END) AS enrolled_study_participant_ids,
  SUM(CASE WHEN PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_missing_participantidentifier,
  SUM(CASE WHEN STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_missing_study_participant_id
FROM IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY

WITH enrolled AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID
  FROM IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY
  WHERE STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL
), hk AS (
  SELECT
    PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER,
    STARTDATE,
    RECORD_DATE,
    VALUE,
    UNITS,
    TO_CHAR(STARTDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_day,
    CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(VALUE), '^[+-]?([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?|\.[0-9]+)$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(VALUE)) END AS value_num
  FROM IHS_2025.HEALTHKITSAMPLES_RESTINGHEARTRATE
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS hk_rows_total,
  COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) AS hk_participants_total,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN hk.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER END) AS enrolled_hk_participants,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN hk.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER || '|' || hk.start_day END) AS enrolled_hk_person_days,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN e.STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS enrolled_hk_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NULL THEN hk.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER END) AS hk_participants_not_in_enrolled_cohort,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hk.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hk_rows_missing_participantidentifier,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hk.STARTDATE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hk_rows_missing_startdate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hk.VALUE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hk_rows_missing_value,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hk.VALUE IS NOT NULL AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(hk.VALUE), '^[+-]?([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?|\.[0-9]+)$') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hk_rows_nonnumeric_value,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hk.value_num IS NOT NULL AND hk.value_num <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hk_rows_nonpositive_value,
  MIN(CASE WHEN e.STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN hk.STARTDATE END) AS enrolled_hk_start_min,
  MAX(CASE WHEN e.STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN hk.STARTDATE END) AS enrolled_hk_start_max,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN hk.UNITS END) AS enrolled_units_count
FROM hk
LEFT JOIN enrolled e
  ON hk.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER = e.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER

WITH enrolled AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID
  FROM IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY
  WHERE STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL
), hk AS (
  SELECT
    PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER,
    STARTDATE,
    RECORD_DATE,
    VALUE,
    UNITS,
    TO_CHAR(STARTDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_day,
    CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(VALUE), '^[+-]?([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?|\.[0-9]+)$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(VALUE)) END AS value_num
  FROM IHS_2025.HEALTHKITSAMPLES_RESTINGHEARTRATE
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS hk_rows_total,
  COUNT(DISTINCT hk.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) AS hk_participants_total,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN hk.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER END) AS enrolled_hk_participants,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN hk.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER || '|' || hk.start_day END) AS enrolled_hk_person_days,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN e.STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS enrolled_hk_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NULL THEN hk.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER END) AS hk_participants_not_in_enrolled_cohort,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hk.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hk_rows_missing_participantidentifier,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hk.STARTDATE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hk_rows_missing_startdate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hk.VALUE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hk_rows_missing_value,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hk.VALUE IS NOT NULL AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(hk.VALUE), '^[+-]?([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?|\.[0-9]+)$') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hk_rows_nonnumeric_value,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hk.value_num IS NOT NULL AND hk.value_num <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hk_rows_nonpositive_value,
  MIN(CASE WHEN e.STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN hk.STARTDATE END) AS enrolled_hk_start_min,
  MAX(CASE WHEN e.STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN hk.STARTDATE END) AS enrolled_hk_start_max,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN hk.UNITS END) AS enrolled_units_count
FROM hk
LEFT JOIN enrolled e
  ON hk.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER = e.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER

WITH enrolled_rows AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID
  FROM IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY
  WHERE STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL
), by_participantidentifier AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, COUNT(*) AS row_count, COUNT(DISTINCT STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID) AS study_id_count
  FROM enrolled_rows
  GROUP BY PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
), by_study_id AS (
  SELECT STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID, COUNT(*) AS row_count, COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) AS participantidentifier_count
  FROM enrolled_rows
  GROUP BY STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrolled_rows) AS enrolled_rows,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM by_participantidentifier) AS enrolled_distinct_participantidentifiers,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM by_study_id) AS enrolled_distinct_study_participant_ids,
  (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN row_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM by_participantidentifier) AS participantidentifiers_with_multiple_rows,
  (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN study_id_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM by_participantidentifier) AS participantidentifiers_with_multiple_study_ids,
  (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN row_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM by_study_id) AS study_ids_with_multiple_rows,
  (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN participantidentifier_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM by_study_id) AS study_ids_with_multiple_participantidentifiers
FROM dual

WITH enrolled AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID
  FROM IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY
  WHERE STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL
), joined AS (
  SELECT
    hk.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER,
    TO_CHAR(hk.STARTDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_day,
    TO_CHAR(hk.RECORD_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS record_day,
    hk.VALUE,
    hk.UNITS
  FROM IHS_2025.HEALTHKITSAMPLES_RESTINGHEARTRATE hk
  INNER JOIN enrolled e
    ON hk.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER = e.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS enrolled_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) AS enrolled_participants,
  COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER || '|' || start_day) AS person_days_by_startdate,
  COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER || '|' || record_day) AS person_days_by_record_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN start_day = record_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_start_day_equals_record_day,
  SUM(CASE WHEN start_day <> record_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_start_day_differs_record_day,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN start_day <> record_day THEN PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER END) AS participants_with_start_record_day_difference,
  MIN(start_day) AS first_start_day,
  MAX(start_day) AS last_start_day,
  MIN(record_day) AS first_record_day,
  MAX(record_day) AS last_record_day
FROM joined

WITH enrolled AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID
  FROM IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY
  WHERE STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL
), joined AS (
  SELECT
    hk.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER,
    TO_CHAR(hk.STARTDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_day,
    COUNT(*) AS samples_on_day
  FROM IHS_2025.HEALTHKITSAMPLES_RESTINGHEARTRATE hk
  INNER JOIN enrolled e
    ON hk.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER = e.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
  GROUP BY hk.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, TO_CHAR(hk.STARTDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS enrolled_person_days,
  SUM(samples_on_day) AS enrolled_samples,
  SUM(CASE WHEN samples_on_day = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS person_days_with_one_sample,
  SUM(CASE WHEN samples_on_day > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS person_days_with_multiple_samples,
  MIN(samples_on_day) AS min_samples_per_person_day,
  MAX(samples_on_day) AS max_samples_per_person_day,
  ROUND(AVG(samples_on_day), 3) AS mean_samples_per_person_day
FROM joined
